sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: A STRONG UPPER TROUGH IS FORECAST TO DIG ACROSS CA TODAY...WHILE WEAK UPPER RIDGING TAKES PLACE OVER MOST AREAS EAST OF THE ROCKIES. DESPITE THE RIDGING ALOFT...RATHER STRONG WESTERLY MID LEVEL FLOW AND INCREASING INSTABILITY WILL RESULT IN A RISK OF SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS OVER SEVERAL AREAS TODAY. AT THE SURFACE A FRONTAL BOUNDARY FROM NRN NC EXTENDS NWWD ACROSS APPALACHIANS THRU WRN WV AND THEN WWD TO N OF OH RIVER...THEN WSWWD ACROSS CENTRAL MO TO SWRN KS/OK BORDER. THIS BOUNDARY SEPARATES THE LARGE WARM SECTOR TO THE S WHICH IS UNDERGOING DESTABILIZATION FROM BOTH THE PRESENCE OF AN EML AND ADVECTION OF GULF MOISTURE...AND A COOLER AIR MASS TO THE N.

sections.title: OH/TN VALLEYS TO WRN CAROLINAS
sections.text: RAPID DESTABILIZATION IS TAKING PLACE EWD ACROSS KY/TN TO S OF FRONTAL BOUNDARY WITH DEWPOINTS RISING INTO THE MID 60S. STRONG HEATING IS OCCURRING THIS AM OVER LOWER OH VALLEY AND WILL LEAD TO A MDTLY UNSTABLE...WEAKLY CAPPED AIR MASS BY EARLY THIS AFTERNOON. MLCAPES AOA 2000 J/KG COUPLED WITH BRN SHEAR OF 50-60KT WILL PROVIDE A FAVORABLE SEVERE THUNDERSTORM ENVIRONMENT PARTICULARLY FOR LARGE HAIL GIVEN THE STEEP MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES. STORMS SHOULD INITIATE VICINITY/S OF THE FRONTAL ZONE NEAR OH RIVER BY EARLY/MID AFTERNOON AND THEN QUICKLY EVOLVE INTO LINE SEGMENTS/BOWS AS WELL AS POSSIBLE SUPERCELLS. VERY LARGE HAIL WOULD BE POSSIBLE ASSOCIATED WITH ANY SUPERCELL GIVEN THE EXPECTED ENVIRONMENT ALONG WITH ISOLATED TORNADOES. HAVE INCREASED BOTH WIND/HAIL PROBS WITH THE POTENTIAL FOR EVEN A HIGHER RISK OF WIND IF STORMS EVOLVE INTO LINE SEGMENTS AND BOWS. ADDITIONALLY HAVE SPREAD THE SLIGHT RISK INTO THE WESTERN CAROLINAS AS IT NOW APPEARS SUFFICIENT INSTABILITY WILL BE PRESENT TO MAINTAIN AN ORGANIZED THREAT GIVEN THE PRESENCE OF 40-50 KT OF SHEAR.

sections.title: OK/KS INTO MID MS AND OH VALLEYS THIS EVENING
sections.text: SURFACE BOUNDARY EXTENDING FROM NEAR THE OK/KS BORDER EASTWARD INTO MO/IL WILL LIKELY BE FOCUS OF SEVERE THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT. OPERATIONAL AND EXPERIMENTAL MODEL SOLUTIONS CONTINUE TO SUPPORT THE DEVELOPMENT OF ISOLATED THUNDERSTORMS BY LATE THIS AFTERNOON OVER NORTHERN OK AND SOUTHEAST KS DESPITE WEAK FORCING ALOFT. STRONG HEATING AND INCREASING MOISTURE WILL HELP TO REDUCE CAP AND AID IN INITIATION. WITH MLCAPES RISING TO 3000 J/KG SUPERCELL STORMS WILL BE LIKELY WITH LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS POSSIBLE. THE ACTIVITY IS EXPECTED TO INCREASE IN COVERAGE AS IT SPREADS EASTWARD ALONG THE BOUNDARY INTO THE MID MS VALLEY...AND EVENTUALLY INTO THE OH VALLEY AFTER MIDNIGHT. DAMAGING WINDS WILL LIKELY BE THE MAIN THREAT...ALTHOUGH LARGE HAIL WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE. IF SUPERCELL STRUCTURES CAN BE SUSTAINED IT WILL INCREASE THE POTENTIAL FOR TORNADOES AND VERY LARGE HAIL. EXPECTED COVERAGE PRECLUDES THE INCREASING LOWER RISK COVERAGE PROBABILITIES ATTM.

sections.title: GULF COAST STATES
sections.text: AMPLE LOW LEVEL MOISTURE HAS RETURNED TO THE GULF COAST REGION THIS MORNING WITH MID/UPR 60 DEWPOINTS AS FAR NORTH AS TN. WIDESPREAD LOW CLOUDS ARE RETARDING THE HEATING THIS MORNING. HOWEVER...CINH WILL DECREASE SUFFICIENTLY THIS AFTERNOON COUPLED WITH TRAILING ASCENT FROM SHORTWAVE TROUGH MOVING ACROSS TN AND MAY RESULT IN A FEW STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS GIVEN THE EXPECTED LARGE CAPE/MARGINAL SHEAR ENVIRONMENT. ..HALES/STOPPKOTTE.. 04/08/2011

sections.title: SERN KS/OK EWD TO WRN VA/WV/THE CAROLINAS
sections.text: FORECAST REMAINS GENERALLY ON TRACK...WITH INITIAL DEEP CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT NOW ONGOING ACROSS THE MID OH VALLEY AND INTO WV. HAVE EXPANDED THE SLIGHT RISK A BIT NEWD TO COVER THE EVOLVING THREAT HERE. WITH TIME...EXPECT CONVECTION TO DEVELOP SWD ACROSS ERN KY AND PARTS OF TN...AND MOVE EWD ACROSS THE APPALACHIANS THROUGH THE EVENING. LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS REMAIN LIKELY WITH THE DEVELOPING STORMS. FARTHER W...CAPPING REMAINS AN ISSUE...THOUGH THE BOUNDARY LAYER APPEARS WARMER/MORE MOIST ACROSS OK AND VICINITY AHEAD OF THE DRYLINE THAT MODELS HAD FORECAST. THUS -- ISOLATED STORM DEVELOPMENT APPEARS A BIT MORE LIKELY THAN EARLIER...SO HAVE EXPANDED SLIGHT RISK ACROSS CENTRAL AND INTO SWRN OK. BY EARLY EVENING...THE INCREASING LOW-LEVEL JET SHOULD SUPPORT MORE WIDESPREAD CONVECTION EWD ACROSS NERN OK/SERN KS AND INTO SRN MO...WHICH SHOULD THEN SPREAD EWD ACROSS THE MID MS VALLEY OVERNIGHT. LARGE HAIL AND LOCALLY-DAMAGING WINDS WILL REMAIN THE PRIMARY THREAT -- WITH SOME POTENTIAL EXPECTED TO LINGER THROUGH THE END OF THE PERIOD INTO THE MID MS/LOWER OH/TN VALLEY REGION. ..GOSS.. 04/08/2011 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1111 AM CDT FRI APR 08 2011/

sections.title: NRN OK/SERN KS/SWRN MO
sections.text: 00Z SOUNDINGS FROM OUN/TOP/SGF EXHIBIT VERY STEEP LAPSE RATES THROUGH A DEEP LAYER...IN THE MEAN ON THE ORDER OF 8C/KM. THIS APPEARS PARTLY RESPONSIBLE FOR INTENSITY OF ONGOING ACTIVITY FROM NCNTRL OK INTO SERN KS WHERE NUMEROUS UPDRAFTS ARE PRODUCING LARGE HAIL AND POSSIBLY DAMAGING WINDS. WITH LLJ...ALBEIT FRAGMENTED...EXPECTED TO REMAIN FOCUSED ACROSS THE SRN PLAINS INTO SWRN MO IT WOULD SEEM REASONABLE THAT A NEWD EXPANSION OF TSTMS WILL BE NOTED WITHIN WARM ADVECTION ZONE ALONG TRAILING FRONTAL ZONE INTO THE MID MS VALLEY DURING THE OVERNIGHT HOURS...EVENTUALLY SPREADING BACK INTO PORTIONS OF THE LOWER OH VALLEY. LATEST VIS IMAGERY SUGGESTS A CONSIDERABLE AMOUNT OF MID LEVEL CONVECTION DEVELOPING ALONG ERN PLUME OF STEEPER LAPSE RATES ACROSS MO INTO NERN AR. THIS CONVECTION SHOULD ONLY INCREASE IN DEPTH AND WILL SOON BEGIN TO PRODUCE LIGHTNING...SOME OF IT COULD GENERATE HAIL.

sections.title: CNTRL APPALACHIANS INTO CNTRL NC
sections.text: CONVECTION CONTINUES TO DEVELOP UPWIND ACROSS ERN KY/SRN WV IN WAKE OF WEAK SHORTWAVE TROUGH. THIS ACTIVITY SHOULD SPREAD SEWD ACROSS THE HIGHER ELEVATIONS INTO CNTRL NC ALONG/NORTH OF WEDGE FRONT. GIVEN THE MOIST/WLY COMPONENT AND STEEPER LAPSE RATE FEED ACROSS KY INTO THIS REGION IT APPEARS ACTIVITY MAY NOT DISSIPATE WITH LOSS OF DAYTIME HEATING BUT RATHER FESTER WITHIN WLY WARM ADVECTION ATOP AFOREMENTIONED FRONTAL ZONE. LARGE HAIL IS THE PRIMARY SEVERE THREAT...ALONG WITH DAMAGING WINDS. ..DARROW.. 04/09/2011
